ValidationRule.description:
If Type = "Travel", then both Start Date and To Date must
be filled.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "Travel"), OR( ISBLANK( From_Date__c ), ISBLANK( To_Date__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage:
If Type = "Travel", then both Start Date and To Date must
be filled.
